objective: Separate the unknown-space starting-cell behavior from A* local-pool bounds using the prior run logs, the closest successful same-profile voxel archive, and two additional snapshot-gate attempts.
scope: Planner/map diagnostic only. No trajectory server, controller, PX4, online truth subscriber, or control output.

source_audit.center_definition: Each AstarSearch centers the local pool at the midpoint of its start and end points.
source_audit.occupied_start_behavior: AStar first maps raw start/end to indices relative to their midpoint. Occupancy is checked at Index2Coord(start_idx/end_idx), which is the midpoint-relative A* cell center, not the raw start/end coordinates. If that quantized cell is blocked, start moves away from end or end moves away from start by 0.1 m until a free cell is found or Coord2Index rejects an out-of-pool point.
source_audit.unknown_candidate_behavior: Experimental patch 0020 makes getInflateOccupancy return occupied for any unknown voxel; the base map snapshot keeps raw unknown separate from the inflation mask.
source_audit.path_vector_guard: Experimental patch 0023 guards the separately confirmed initControlPoints A* path-vector boundary read; it does not change unknown occupancy or map geometry.
source_audit.cell_query_semantics: The EGO optimizer collision log reports occupancy at a raw control point. That is not necessarily the cell AStar checks after midpoint-relative coordinate quantization.

same_profile_snapshot.qualification: The archive is a fresh same-profile cross-run sample after a goal, not the exact #307 warning window. The room/target profile and initial local frame are comparable; no cross-session stitching.

prior_planner_run.sanitizer: No ASan report in attempt 06; ASan had confirmed the separate vector over-read in attempt 04.

interpretation: The #306 cross-run snapshot confirms that the map-origin voxel and the #307 optimizer collision-point voxel are raw unknown; both have inflation-mask value 0. Experimental patch 0020 converts unknown to occupied for EGO collision checks. This explains why that optimizer diagnostic reports the control point as blocked.

A* does not test the raw control point for its start check: it tests Index2Coord(start_idx), using the midpoint-relative local-grid index. In the representative #307 direction_failed pair projected onto #306, the rounded start cell is known free; the end cell is unknown and one 0.1 m outward adjustment reaches a known-free cell. This pair does not reproduce the pool-boundary error.

The 288 pool-boundary errors therefore remain unexplained. Other A* input segments, runtime map contents, or endpoints may differ; the current logs do not record per-call start/end/center/index/occupancy. Do not attribute those errors to the unknown launch cell without that trace.
limitations: The fresh successful archive is from a separate run, although it used the same wall/goal profile.
Both #308 attempts failed the fresh-fused-depth gate, so they produced no voxel data and sent no goal. Attempt 02 did not retain proof that force commands were published.
No candidate fix was built or qualified. The 0.5 m inflation and patches 0020/0023 remain experimental; no map coverage, vehicle clearance, trajectory execution, or flight result is claimed.
The #307 optimizer control-point occupancy and the A* quantized start/end occupancy are different queries; the cross-run snapshot projection cannot substitute for per-call runtime trace.
next_diagnostic: Add isolated low-volume A* diagnostics that record requested start/end, midpoint, quantized start/end indices, queried cell centers, unknown/inflated class, adjustment count, and exact out-of-pool point for every failed AstarSearch. Then rerun the same planner-only target; do not make a root-cause claim until failing calls are matched.

astar_pair_projection.result: This representative cross-run pair does not reproduce an A* pool exit: its rounded start cell is known free; its end cell is unknown, and one 0.1 m adjustment reaches a known-free cell in this snapshot. It cannot explain the 288 logged #307 pool errors.
